armor_penetration.source: GAU-8 PGU-14/B API: 76 mm at 300 m and 59 mm at 1,000 m of BHN-300 RHA at 30 degrees from vertical; converted to a square impact by the solver's own 1/cos rule (76/cos30 = 88, 59/cos30 = 68, i.e. 28 mm per km). SuperbWarfare arms its J-16 with the GAU-8 ("30mm_gau_8_a"); kept as given
